title: Homogeneous pieces of module localization at one element
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M$ an $A$-module, $(M_n)_{n\in\mathbb Z}$ a family of additive subgroups of $M$, $s\in A$, and $d,n\in\mathbb Z$. In the localization $M_s$ at the powers of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], define $P_n(M,s,d)=\{m/s^k\mid k\in\mathbb N,\ m\in M_{n+kd}\}$. When $M$ is graded and $s$ is homogeneous of degree $d$, this is the underlying set of the homogeneous degree-$n$ part of the localized module; $P_0(M,s,d)$ is its degree-zero part.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09MR proof, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph (localization exactness)
